purpose: Construct and measure one typed workflow step with existing native geometry, material, renderer, motion or code tools.

properties.operation: one implemented operator action in atlas/operators/native.json
properties.values: exact named input ports from the corresponding operator contract
properties.path: new ordinary directory retaining inputs and observations

limitations: Only installed typed operators and explicit finite search, execution and validation scopes.
Fresh outcome checks are required; no silent canon or capability admission.
